description: HHS emPOWER is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The map provides de-identified administrative insurance claims data, updated monthly, on Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage (Parts A, B, and C) beneficiaries, which includes enrolled Americans ages 65 and over, and disabled Americans under age 65. The totals listed here may underestimate the total at-risk Medicare beneficiary population due to certain Medicare policies and processes. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Health, Electricity. Its keywords are medicare, durable medical equipment (DME). The portal shows 2024-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
